description: This file defines the class PdfNameTreeNode, which models a node in a PDF Name Tree structure within the PDFsharp library. It provides methods for managing name entries, child nodes, and node limits, and supports traversal and querying of the name tree.

classes.name: PdfNameTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a PDF Name Tree structure within the PDFsharp library. Handles child nodes, name entries, and key limits, and supports querying and modification of the tree.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of names in the node; optionally includes names from child nodes.

methods.name: ContainsName
methods.description: Checks whether the node (or its children, if specified) contains a specific name.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specified name, including following references.

methods.name: AddKid
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds a key-value name pair to this node.
